description: Type the 409 `agent_outdated` getCommandStatus gets when the sandbox agent is too old for log offsets. The spec documents it on GET /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/commands/{processId} ("A sandbox agent too old for offsets answers 409 `agent_outdated`"); it generated as a bare Conflict. Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The sandbox agent is too old for `stdoutOffset` / `stderrOffset`. Poll without offsets.
